findings.summary: The business-module capability declares initialization as a subordinate concern but does not wire the initialization capability as a dependency.
findings.evidence: In domains/engineering/harmonyos/capabilities.json, harmonyos-business-module-development states that initialization remains subordinate, but its dependencies contain only stage-application-and-package-design, arkts-implementation-and-static-correctness, arkui-interface-delivery, and harmonyos-build-and-runtime-verification; its skills likewise omit hmos-init-business-module. This conflicts with requirements.md AC-04, workflows/WORKFLOW.md track 5 step 2, and skills/hmos-business-module-development/SKILL.md, which conditionally invokes hmos-init-business-module when the module pair is absent. A resolver that selects Skills through declared capability dependencies cannot discover that conditional prerequisite from this capability record, leaving the missing-scaffold journey incompletely wired.
